title: Add interactive toolchain skeleton and stepwise onboarding docs
author: Anika Patel
description: Introduce an interactive, stepwise developer quickstart that demonstrates building a minimal toolchain-enabled agent and onboarding workflow. Motivation: provide a compact, runnable guide that bridges the gap between conceptual docs and fully featured examples; targeted at new engineers evaluating Redwood tool-calling and RAG patterns. This PR includes: 1) a lightweight Node/TS playground service that runs locally with a single script; 2) a step-by-step README designed for incremental learning (setup -> local run -> instrumented assertions -> telemetry hooks); 3) modular tool stub templates (TS and shell) that show explicit contract boundaries; 4) a small docs snippet for the docs site that surfaces the quickstart as an interactive card. Checklist: - [x] Add playground server and runner script; - [x] Write stepwise onboarding README with explicit checkpoints and expected outputs; - [x] Include tool-stub templates and inline lint rules; - [x] Hook minimal telemetry probes (dev-only) to demonstrate tracing integration; - [x] Add CI smoke job to validate quickstart runs in container; - [x] Update docs site snippets and navigation entry. Notes: aims to be non-opinionated about state management; the example uses an ephemeral in-process index for simplicity. See linked Linear tickets for follow-ups (ENG-1426 handles expanding language adapters; PM-88 tracks docs placement).
